title: Offline Reinforcement Learning as One Big Sequence Modeling Problem

methods.one_paragraph_description: Trajectory Transformer discretizes each state/action/reward/reward-to-go dimension into tokens (uniform discretization), trains a GPT-style decoder autoregressively on the token stream, and at runtime plans with beam search: candidate sequences are scored by predicted cumulative reward plus the model's reward-to-go estimate (return-maximizing beam search), the first action of the best sequence is executed, and the search is repeated as a receding-horizon controller.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: sequence modeling as offline RL / model-based planning ('we use beam search (Reddy, 1977), a ... in place of the trajectory optimizers common in model-based control'; 'Offline Reinforcement Learning as One Big Sequence Modeling Problem')
